title: Residue fields of the fibre ring
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pA_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $C=B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ and $j:B\to C$, $b\mapsto b\otimes1$. Let $\mathfrak Q\subset C$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak q=j^{-1}(\mathfrak Q)$. Then the local homomorphism $B_{\mathfrak q}\to C_{\mathfrak Q}$, $b/s\mapsto j(b)/j(s)$, is surjective, and the field homomorphism it induces on residue fields, $\iota:\kappa(\mathfrak q)=B_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak qB_{\mathfrak q}\to\kappa(\mathfrak Q)=C_{\mathfrak Q}/\mathfrak QC_{\mathfrak Q}$, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Remark Tag 0H9M (remark-local-ring-fibre, line 3520): $F_{\overline{\mathfrak q}}\cong S_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{R_{\mathfrak p}}\kappa(\mathfrak p)\cong S_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak pS_{\mathfrak q}$, a quotient of $S_{\mathfrak q}$, whose residue field is therefore $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$
